subject: Apply a golden hour / magic hour LUT. See .rundeer/luts/golden_hour.md for the full LUT specification. Flood the frame with warm amber-gold from a low directional sun angle, introduce long soft shadows with a cool purple-blue fill, slightly overexpose highlights to a creamy roll-off, intensify warm skin tone rendering, add a subtle atmospheric haze in the far background, make sky gradients transition from deep orange-red at the horizon to warm cobalt above.
